name: brightness
title: Brightness
description: Adjust display brightness on macOS by driving the BetterDisplay CLI instead of Lunar.
author: frank

commands.name: increase-brightness
commands.title: Increase Brightness
commands.description: Raise the brightness of the target display by the configured step

commands.name: decrease-brightness
commands.title: Decrease Brightness
commands.description: Lower the brightness of the target display by the configured step

commands.name: set-brightness
commands.title: Set Brightness
commands.description: Set the target display brightness to an exact percentage

commands.name: maximize-brightness
commands.title: Maximize Brightness
commands.description: Set the target display brightness to 100 percent

commands.name: show-brightness
commands.title: Show Brightness
commands.description: Report the current brightness of the target display

preferences.name: step
preferences.title: Step
preferences.description: Percentage points added or removed by the increase and decrease commands.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: BetterDisplay CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the betterdisplaycli executable provided by the BetterDisplay app.
